Classified_Outcome: Outcome B: Curves Differ Moderately, but Ambiguity Scores Converge to Nearly Identical Values
Outcome_Description: Different camera initializations reach distinct spectral sensitivity curves with virtually identical metameric ambiguity (CV = 2.03%). Commercial cameras (Canon, Nikon, Point Grey) converge to the exact same optimum (0.3318-0.3319). This provides robust empirical evidence for a smooth near-optimal valley in the 12D parameter space.
